reference_sql:
WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product and price version, with the list price of the version before it
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, valid_to, list_price_eur,
         LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price_eur
  FROM price_history
),
promo_products AS (
  -- one row per 2025 promotion and product, with the version in effect on the promotion's first day
  SELECT pr.promo_code, pr.start_date, v.list_price_eur, v.prev_price_eur,
         pr.start_date - v.valid_from AS days_before
  FROM promotions AS pr
  JOIN promotion_products AS pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
  JOIN versions AS v ON v.product_id = pp.product_id
   AND v.valid_from <= pr.start_date
   AND (v.valid_to >= pr.start_date OR v.valid_to IS NULL)
  WHERE pr.start_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND pr.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
)
-- one row per promotion
SELECT promo_code, start_date,
       COUNT(*) AS n_products,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE list_price_eur > prev_price_eur AND days_before <= 14) AS n_raised,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE list_price_eur < prev_price_eur AND days_before <= 14) AS n_cut,
       ROUND(MAX(100.0 * (list_price_eur - prev_price_eur) / prev_price_eur)
             FILTER (WHERE list_price_eur > prev_price_eur AND days_before <= 14), 1) AS max_rise_pct
FROM promo_products
GROUP BY promo_code, start_date
ORDER BY n_raised DESC, promo_code

WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product and price version, with the previous version's list price
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, valid_to, list_price_eur,
         LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from ASC) AS old_price
  FROM price_history
),
flags AS (
  -- one row per 2025 promotion and product, with a raised flag, a cut flag and the price change
  SELECT pr.promo_code, pr.start_date,
         CASE WHEN v.list_price_eur > v.old_price AND date_diff('day', v.valid_from, pr.start_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_raised,
         CASE WHEN v.list_price_eur < v.old_price AND date_diff('day', v.valid_from, pr.start_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cut,
         100.0 * (v.list_price_eur - v.old_price) / v.old_price AS change_pct
  FROM promotions AS pr
  JOIN promotion_products AS pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
  JOIN versions AS v ON v.product_id = pp.product_id
  WHERE pr.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    AND pr.start_date BETWEEN v.valid_from AND COALESCE(v.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
-- one row per promotion
SELECT promo_code, start_date, COUNT(*) AS n_products,
       SUM(is_raised) AS n_raised, SUM(is_cut) AS n_cut,
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN is_raised = 1 THEN change_pct END), 1) AS max_rise_pct
FROM flags
GROUP BY promo_code, start_date
ORDER BY n_raised DESC, promo_code ASC

WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product and price version, with the price before it and the day the next version starts
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
         LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price_eur,
         LEAD(valid_from) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS next_from
  FROM price_history
),
on_start AS (
  -- one row per 2025 promotion and product: the version in effect on the start date
  SELECT pr.promo_code, pr.start_date, v.valid_from, v.list_price_eur, v.prev_price_eur
  FROM promotions AS pr
  JOIN promotion_products AS pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
  JOIN versions AS v ON v.product_id = pp.product_id
  WHERE pr.start_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND pr.start_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND v.valid_from <= pr.start_date
    AND (v.next_from > pr.start_date OR v.next_from IS NULL)
)
-- one row per promotion
SELECT promo_code, start_date,
       COUNT(*) AS n_products,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE list_price_eur > prev_price_eur AND valid_from >= start_date - 14) AS n_raised,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE list_price_eur < prev_price_eur AND valid_from >= start_date - 14) AS n_cut,
       MAX(ROUND(100.0 * (list_price_eur - prev_price_eur) / prev_price_eur, 1))
         FILTER (WHERE list_price_eur > prev_price_eur AND valid_from >= start_date - 14) AS max_rise_pct
FROM on_start
GROUP BY promo_code, start_date
ORDER BY n_raised DESC, promo_code

solver.query:
WITH pp AS (
  SELECT pr.promo_id, pr.promo_code, pr.start_date, pp.product_id
  FROM promotions pr JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
  WHERE pr.start_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND pr.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
),
ver AS (
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, valid_to, list_price_eur,
         LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
),
x AS (
  SELECT pp.promo_id, pp.promo_code, pp.start_date, pp.product_id, v.list_price_eur, v.prev_price,
         (pp.start_date - v.valid_from) AS d
  FROM pp LEFT JOIN ver v ON v.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND v.valid_from <= pp.start_date AND (v.valid_to IS NULL OR v.valid_to >= pp.start_date)
),
f AS (
  SELECT *, (prev_price IS NOT NULL AND list_price_eur > prev_price AND d BETWEEN 0 AND 14) AS raised,
            (prev_price IS NOT NULL AND list_price_eur < prev_price AND d BETWEEN 0 AND 14) AS cut
  FROM x
)
SELECT promo_code, start_date, COUNT(*) AS n_products, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE raised) AS n_raised, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cut) AS n_cut, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN raised THEN 100.0*(list_price_eur-prev_price)/prev_price END),1) AS max_rise_pct FROM f GROUP BY promo_code, start_date ORDER BY n_raised DESC, promo_code;
